findings.location: owner_ingress.py verify: roles and member owner comparison
findings.observation: A nonempty roles dict can contain None or empty strings. core.owner_ref equal to that value passes; no text validation or allowed category set is applied. A disposable independently signed technical probe accepted a null governing owner.
findings.required_revision: Require exact original allowed owner category keys and nonempty textual owner role values, plus nonempty core.owner_ref/core.target_ref and target category/version identity. Reject None, empty/whitespace role values and undeclared categories causally. Preserve no actual owner authority in fixtures.

findings.observation: The displayed material digest is only syntactically validated. Role evidence refs/digests are only required to be unique well-formed rows. Signatures and independently expected whole-envelope hashes authenticate the issuer claim, but the verifier has no independently expected displayed material/evidence list with which to compare it. Current test presentation uses arbitrary c*64 and role source evidence arbitrary b*64.
findings.required_constraint: Actual coordinator/host integration must independently capture and verify the exact complete rendered review material and governing authority basis/evidence dependencies before selecting the whole envelope pins. Prefer explicit expected display/evidence bindings in Selection and causal changed/omitted display or governing evidence tests; otherwise make the external verifier prerequisite executable and retained in frozen integration evidence. Never infer body verification from a well-formed digest.

findings.observation: ReplayJournal checks root mode and non-symlink leaf, but does not anchor parents/root inode/uid across reserve. The contract requires trusted coordinator to protect it against replacement/deletion. No publisher lock/commit integration is present.
findings.required_constraint: Before actual use independently select and protect the journal root and every parent, validate owner/attachment, and hold anchored root and publication locks through reserve/current reverify/atomic commit. Test directory replacement, concurrent reserve and crash/restart consumption on the integrated path. Preserve prior committed exact repair without consuming/reapproving messages again.

findings.location: actual host issuer / governing resolver / publication gate
findings.observation: Caller identity and governing-role authenticity depend on independent out-of-band trust origin and live resolver, correctly documented but not implemented/selected. An in-process caller can construct actual-owner TrustContext; it is outside stated boundary and cannot be exposed through an API.
findings.required_constraint: Actual production bootstrap must select authentic host human-message and exact presentation issuance plus separate live governing authority resolver; no fixture-generated anchor installation. Persist exact trust origins, cursor selection and complete review/source/authority bytes. Original publisher must invoke mandatory actual-owner gate and replay reservation with fresh currentness inside its existing locks. Existing fixture helper must not bypass this path.

review_scope: Read-only owner ingress, contract and tests against actual original RepositoryAuthority.core/promotion encoding. No publisher integration or real host owner evidence exists.
sound_parts: TrustContext and Selection are typed coordinator inputs rather than deserialized request fields; incoming issuer/key/usage flags cannot select trust. Contract explicitly forbids public anchor registration. Distinct host and governing registry issuer/key are enforced.

Whole independently selected signed envelopes, exact semantic review/authority digests, ordered original pretty core digests, target/role comparisons, immutable host conversation/message identities and UTF-8 content digest are checked.

Current registry cursor and authority period, presentation before message and actual UTC time are checked. Reject/revise evidence can verify but cannot publish. Technical positive trust cannot pass verify_for_publication.

Replay reservation uses exclusive O_NOFOLLOW creation, fsync and host/mechanism/conversation/message identity. Contract keeps crash reconciliation and immutable committed repair distinct from a new commit.

No signing function, actual issuer/resolver installation, publisher wiring, real approving outcome, native admission or R08 completion is claimed. The claim ceiling accurately requires those external mechanisms.
